comment_info: Configuration for Lighter-Aster Delta Neutral Hedge Bot
comment_symbols: List of symbols to monitor (without USDT suffix)
comment_notional: Position size in USD per trade
comment_hold_duration: How long to hold each position in hours (8h = 1 Aster funding cycle, 8 Lighter payments)
_comment_hold_duration_hours: RAISED 8.0 -> 24.0. Break-even APR = roundtrip_fee_pct * (8760/hold_hours). Round trip here is only 0.080% because Lighter is genuinely zero-fee (Aster taker 0.040% on both legs, entry and exit). At 8h that is an 87.6% break-even against observed selected APRs averaging 75.8% - just under water. At 24h it falls to 29.2%, which those same opportunities clear.
comment_wait: Minutes to wait between position cycles
comment_check_interval: Seconds between position health checks while holding
comment_min_apr: Minimum net APR threshold to open positions (in percentage)
_comment_min_net_apr_threshold: RAISED 5.0 -> 60.0. Gross funding-spread threshold, sized to clear the 29.2% break-even at the new 24h hold with ~2x margin. NOTE: Lighter APRs were previously understated 8x by a hardcoded periods_per_day=3, so historical rankings under the old threshold are not comparable.
comment_stop_loss: Enable automatic stop-loss based on leverage
comment_funding_refresh: Minutes between funding rate table refreshes while holding position
comment_capital_safety: Capital safety margin (0.95 = use 95% of available capital, keeping 5% buffer for fees/slippage)
